mentions.name: ALT
mentions.description: A no-code platform for load, stress, and performance testing APIs. It offers pre-defined and customizable load profiles executed via globally distributed machines, delivers key performance metrics in seconds without scripting, and supports direct import of Postman collections.
mentions.source_excerpt: ALT (https://www.APILoadTest.com): I recently built ALT as a no-code platform to load/stress/performance test APIs with pre-defined (and customizable) load profiles, via globally distributed machines. The goal is simple: key performance metrics, in seconds, without scripting.
